correctness.rationale: Writing e_i=mw_i−1 gives Be=(0,−S_m) with columns (1,X_i); conditioning successively on the affine spans gives full row rank almost surely, simultaneously for all m≥d+1. The dual of the quotient of the sup norm maximizes |u·S_m|/||B^T(a,u)||_1. Minimizing over a for unit u gives the stated median-centered sum (positive by full rank). The compact parameter set |a|≤1, ||u||=1 contains sample minimizers and has a pointwise Lipschitz bound uniform over X, so countable finite nets plus the strong law give uniform convergence of the objectives, and hence of their minima. Symmetry and convexity put the population minimum at zero; the spherical first-coordinate mean absolute value is Γ(d/2)/(√π Γ((d+1)/2)). Thus √m T_m differs from ||S_m/√m||/c_d by o_P(1); the covariance is I_d/d. At d=2 the chi survival yields exp(−4t²/π²). The fixed-radius box forces positive weights once t/√m<1. Inspected RESULT.md lines 34–75 and the two supporting files. The 72 recorded LP cases use solver-returned multipliers and numerical tolerances, do not independently estimate the law, and were not replayed.
